title: Your first node, in V1 and in V3
hook: The same node written both ways, run through the real engine on a CPU. They look different, and the validator can't tell them apart.

verified.claim: A V3 node's INPUT_TYPES returns the same shape of dictionary as a V1 node's.
Both forms ran through PromptExecutor with the same result, and V3's execute received a class named V3BrightClone.
verified.ref: in-process run on a CPU with test nodes added to NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS

verified.claim: A V1 function returning a bare value fails with TypeError: object of type 'int' has no len().
Changing an input in place corrupts the cached output of the node upstream: the mean went 0.3755, 0.6255, 0.8755 over three queues.
verified.ref: in-process run with the classic cache

verified.claim: The loader reads NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS first and returns, and uses comfy_entrypoint only if that is absent.
Packs are loaded once, at startup.
A V1 node returning a bare image tensor raised nothing: the next node got [H, W, C], the first image alone, and ImageScale then raised ValueError.
verified.ref: execution.py:merge_result_data, test node through PromptExecutor on a CPU, batches of 1 and 2

verified.claim: The traceback is logged when a pack fails to load, and (IMPORT FAILED) appears later in the import times list.

unchecked: We ran these nodes by adding them to the node table inside one process. We did not install them as a pack in a running server for this lesson.
Whether a later ComfyUI will drop V1. Nothing in v0.43.0 removes it, and core still has V1 nodes such as ImageInvert.
